arguments.message:
Hi! You can set your email alerts so you only get notified about work assigned to you. In Meridian, notification preferences are per‑person:
1. Open **Profile → Notifications**.
2. Keep the **Assignment** notification toggle turned on.
3. Turn off the other types (Mentions, Status changes, Digest emails) by toggling them off.
This way you’ll receive emails only for items assigned to you, without any other notification noise.
